genxml.title: MACE peripheral two-wire bus block as the IRIX video driver drives it
genxml.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
genxml.doc: Configuration, control and data words of the MACE peripheral's two-wire bus, which the video driver uses to program video-port chips. The bus is base 0x1f330000. Prose and the reasoning are in docs/mace-video.md.

struct.name: TW_CONFIG
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Bus configuration word. The configuration helper reads it and writes it back with the bits selected by its mask replaced. The driver writes 1 to request a bus reset. Meanings of the other values written are not recorded.

struct.name: TW_CONTROL
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Bus control and status word. Transfer routines poll the status bits below. Writes of 1, 3 and 5 are commands, and their meanings are inferred in docs/mace-video.md.

struct.name: TW_DATA
struct.from: shipped IRIX O2 video driver object, per docs/mace-video.md
struct.doc: Data word. The read and write routines store the chip address byte and the register number byte through it, and read it back after the transfer. How its bytes map to bits is not recorded.
